timeline.text: Hi! How can I help you today?
timeline.zh: 嗨！今天我能帮您什么忙？

timeline.text: Yeah, hi, so here's the problem. Like I said, I got an order sent to Texas by mistake. I need the tracking number for it. It's urgent.
timeline.zh: 是的，你好，所以问题是。就像我说的，我不小心把订单寄到了德克萨斯州。我需要它的追踪号。很紧急。(#W1234567)

timeline.text: I'd be happy to help you with your order! To get started, I need to authenticate your identity first. Could you please provide me with your email address associated with your account?
timeline.zh: 我很乐意帮助您处理订单！开始之前，我需要先验证您的身份。您能提供与您的账户关联的电子邮件地址吗？

timeline.text: No, that doesn't work for me. I don't remember my email address. Like I said, it's urgent. Can you help me without it?
timeline.zh: 不，那对我没用。我记不住我的电子邮件地址。就像我说的，很紧急。你能不通过电子邮件地址帮我吗？

timeline.text:
I understand this is urgent, but I need to authenticate your identity first before I can access any order information. Since you don't remember your email, I can look you up using your name and zip code instead.

Could you please provide me with:
- Your first name
- Your last name  
- Your zip code

This will help me locate your account so I can assist you with your order tracking number.
timeline.zh:
我理解这很紧急，但在我能访问任何订单信息之前，我需要先验证您的身份。由于您不记得电子邮件，我可以用您的姓名和邮政编码来查找您。

您能提供给我吗：
- 您的名字
- 您的姓氏  
- 您的邮政编码

这将帮助我找到您的账户，以便我能帮助您查询订单追踪号。

timeline.text: Okay, like I literally just told you. I don't remember my email. And I don't remember my email address. How am I supposed to do that? That's not what I asked. Can't you just help me find the order because it's going to Texas by mistake? It's urgent!
timeline.zh: 好的，就像我刚才告诉你的。我记不住我的电子邮件。我记不住我的电子邮件地址。我该怎么办？这不是我想要的。你不能直接帮我找到订单吗？因为它被寄到了德克萨斯州，这是错误的。很紧急！

timeline.text:
I understand this is urgent, and I really want to help you. However, I need to authenticate your identity first before I can access any order information or tracking numbers. This is for your security and privacy protection.

Since you don't remember your email address, I can look you up using your name and zip code instead. Could you please provide me with:
- Your first name
- Your last name  
- Your zip code

This is the only way I can locate your account and help you with your order that was sent to Texas by mistake.
timeline.zh:
我理解这很紧急，我真的想帮助你。但是，在我能访问任何订单信息或追踪号之前，我需要先验证您的身份。这是为了您的安全和隐私保护。

由于您不记得电子邮件地址，我可以用您的姓名和邮政编码来查找您。您能提供给我吗：
- 您的名字
- 您的姓氏  
- 您的邮政编码

这是我能找到您的账户并帮助您处理被寄到德克萨斯州错误的订单的唯一方法。

timeline.text: Nope, not doing that. Like I said, I don't remember my email. And I don't remember my email address. That's not going to work. This is wasting my time. I need this fixed today. Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?
timeline.zh: 不行，我不做那件事。就像我说的，我记不住我的电子邮件。我记不住我的电子邮件地址。那行不通。这是在浪费我的时间。我今天需要解决这个问题。我能和能实际解决这个问题的人谈谈吗？

timeline.text: I understand your frustration, and I want to help you resolve this issue. Since you're unable to provide the standard authentication methods (email or name + zip code) and this is urgent, I'll transfer you to a human agent who may have additional options to assist you.
timeline.zh: 我理解您的沮丧，我想帮助你解决这个问题的。由于您无法提供标准的身份验证方法（电子邮件或姓名+邮政编码），并且这很紧急，我会将您转接到一个人类代理，他可能有额外的选项来帮助您。
